highlights: UGREEN Uno charger: UGREEN creative series charger, robot shape, LED screen, showing different interesting expressions according to different charging status. Its feet are magnetic and can be stuck on the refrigerator or computer without getting lost( Note: The expression will only appear when the power is on.)

Powerful and Fast 65W Charging: This GaN charger can charge your MacBook Air M2 from 0 to 51% in just 30 min with single USB-C port, and when you use single USB C port or combination USB C and USB A port, it will provide you a maximum total output of 65W
Compact Design: Power up to 3 devices with a charger that's the same size as the AirPods Pro case, so you don't need to carry a bunch of adapters when you travel

Wide Compatibility: 2 USB C ports and 1 USB A port provide 65W to phones, tablets, laptops, and more, compatible with iPhone 8-16 Series, Galaxy S10-S24 Series, Pixel 8/7/6, MacBook Air/Pro, iPad Pro/Air/mini, Watch 8/7, HomePod, AirPods Pro, and more

Comprehensive Protection: The 65W charger uses GaN technology, which has low heat generation and low energy loss, ensuring efficient use of energy. Equipped with overvoltage, overcurrent, overheating, and short circuit protection to protect your devices
Fun & Functional: A playful 65W charger with a robot face that reacts to charging.
Super-Fast Charging: Powers a MacBook Air M2 to 51% in just 30 minutes.
LED Display: Expressions change to show charging status.
Charge Multiple Devices: 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port for all your tech.
Built-in Protections: Efficient GaN tech with multiple safety features.
